caseNameFull: Albert Pick & Company, in Error v. Frank C. Jordan, Secretary of State of the State of California
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of California.'
attorneys: Mr. W. I. Brobeck for plaintiff in error., Mr. U. S. Webb and Mr. Raymond Benjamin for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Kansas City, &c. Railway Co. v. Kansas, 240 U. S. 227.
